## Problem

What are you trying to do that the server doesn't support today? Describe the
use case, not just the solution.

## Proposed solution

What you'd like to see — a new tool, a new flag, a behavior change. If it maps
to a specific Zendesk API endpoint, link the
[API reference](https://developer.zendesk.com/api-reference/).

## Alternatives considered

Other approaches you've thought about, and why they fall short.

## Scope

- [ ] Read-only (no data is modified in Zendesk)
- [ ] Write operation (creates/updates/deletes data in Zendesk)

## Additional context

Anything else — examples, screenshots, links.
